footer_credits: ft_transcendence · 42 · Art inspired by Tiny Swords
about_intro: The final project of the 42 common core: a full web platform built around a real-time multiplayer game. Ours is a Vampire Survivors-like made in Unity: hold out against waves of enemies, alone or with friends, straight in the browser.
about_stack_frontend_text: Pages, profiles, friends and the game page, rendered on the server.
about_stack_game_text: 2D wave survival with Netcode for GameObjects and Unity Relay.
about_stack_backend_text: API routes, accounts, sessions and game data, stored in PostgreSQL.
about_stack_art_text: Pixel-art units, castles and islands that set the look of the whole site.
about_cta_title: Think you can beat our scores?
about_cta_player: Jump into a run and climb the leaderboard.
about_cta_guest: Create an account and climb the leaderboard.
